GAUSSIAN ENVIRONMENT

Enter the ID of a completed job containing Dense Environment. Keep request_id empty to create a fresh job each Run.

Uses retained TrackAnything masks, solved cameras and filtered dense points. No camera solve is rerun.

Requires the worker’s optional LichtFeld executable. Outputs: Gaussian PLY, camera-path preview, nearby-view preview and mask contact sheet.

Static environment only; moving subjects are excluded. Review masks before increasing training settings.
